The FloPlast 110mm uPVC vent terminal is an essential component for any soil and vent drainage system, designed to facilitate proper air circulation and prevent foul odours. Manufactured from durable uPVC, this grey vent terminal ensures robust and long-lasting performance in various outdoor environments. Its 110mm diameter fits standard drainage pipework, making it suitable for both new installations and system upgrades. The reliable solvent weld connection provides a secure and watertight seal, crucial for efficient ventilation. This vent terminal is a straightforward solution for plumbers and builders seeking dependable drainage components.
